scenes.desc: Three nodes on a line, then: 3 cohorts / ~160 students / 7 places to check (the seven tick in).
Notifications from seven different places pile up, freeze at 16.0, implode 17-18.
DROP. The new DSBA Hub logo: 'One place to start.' + honest subline + 5 pills.
Feature 1 - the newsletter in a 3D browser frame: CFA Research Challenge, Student Council, Speech Day, the launch.
Feature 2 - Forum: the 'am I cooked' maths thread is typed, posted, answered across cohorts; easter egg.
Montage: library (real notes), lessons (real lecture frames), Career Navigator, calendar, grades, search; cohorts network; 'Built by students.'
'Launching today' + LAUNCH button + 3/2/1 countdown + click at 67.85.
Glitch #1: freeze, corruption, error windows, static, black.
Darkness, a collar bell, two eyes. Lights on: Noor's cat in a party hat, 'Happy Birthday, Noor', gold confetti.
Glitch #2: song cut on the final 'you', scramble, terminal 'wrong target', crescendo, flash, black+silence.
Letter to the teachers, typed line by line over soft piano; riser into the drop.
DROP: HAPPY TEACHER'S DAY, gold, particles; 'Yes, it was yesterday.'
'We study data. So we ran the numbers on you.' Four statistics jokes, one card each (4 s).
The three cohorts as one network; the ~160 dots gather into THANK YOU.
Happy Teacher's Day sign-off, logos, the cat's P.S., fade to black.
